parameters.name: ContactFlowVersionId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact flow version.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description:
The voice satisfaction survey content.

1. The key press information configured in Content must correspond to the prompt tones.
2. The key press information must correspond to the content in the mapping of url.pressKeyMapping.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance for which to obtain phone numbers.

parameters.name: IsAppraise
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the voice satisfaction survey. Default value: **true**.
